name: court-operations-closeout
description: Produce a clerk-ready structured JSON answer for court disposition / financial closeout tasks (criminal sentencing registers, traffic-citation payment plans, post-sentencing field packets, installment/probation/license orders). Use when a prompt asks you to reconcile local court materials (hearing notes, audit memos, finance-queue extracts, worksheets, petition summaries, intake facts, form excerpts) against a read-only "Court Operations Portal" and emit output matching a provided answer_template.json. Trigger words: closeout, disposition, reconciliation, register totals, fee reconciliation, payment plan / installment order, probation referral, license suspension, petition, docket entry, clerk, citation, sentencing packet, CC-1375 / CC-1379 / DC-211-style forms.
